senses.gloss:
रथ- + अङ्ग रथ- + अङ्ग,
 I. n. 1. any part of a carriage. 2. a wheel.
 II. m. the ruddy goose, Anas casarca.
रथाङ्ग रथाङ्ग, i. e. रथ-अङ्ग- (= चक्र), m. a name of Viṣṇu.
रथ- + ईशा रथ- + ईशा, f. the pole of a car, Chr. 34, 14.
रथ- + उत्तम रथ- + उत्तम, m. an excellent cart, Bhag. 1, 24.
रथ- + उपस्थ रथ- + उपस्थ, m. and n. the carioteer's seat for driving.
रथ- + कुटुम्बिन् रथ- + कुटुम्बिन्, m. a charioteer, Rām. 6, 89, 19.
रथ- + गुप्ति रथ- + गुप्ति, f. an apparatus encompassing a war-chariot, to secure it from being injured by weapons or collision.
रथ-चर्या रथ-चर्या, f. a chariot-exercise.
रथ- + ज्वर रथ- + ज्वर, m. a crow.
रथ-अङ्ग-श्रोणि-विम्ब रथ-अङ्ग-श्रोणि-विम्ब, adj., f. बा, having buttocks [] like the part (half) of a wheel, i. e. semicircular, Vikr. d. 100.

रथ रथ (vb. ऋ), m.
 1. A car, Hit. pr. d. 32, M.M.; a war chariot, Chr. 4, 10.
 2. Any vehicle.
 3. A [] limb.
 4. A foot.
 5. The body.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. Lat. rota; A.S. and O.H.G. rad (probably borrowed); probably ῥέθος; Goth. lithus; A.S. lidh.
रथकट्या रथकट्या, i. e. रथ-कट + य (cf. कट and निकट), f. A multitude of cars.
रथकर रथ-कर, m. A carpenter.

रथकार रथ-कार, m.
 1. A carpenter, Pañc. 229, 8.
 2. A man sprung from a male of the माहिष्य and a female of the करणी caste, by profession a coach-maker.
रथकारत्व रथकार + त्व, n. The business of a carpenter, Pañc. 228, 12.
रथगर्भक रथ-गर्भ + क, m. A car or litter borne on men's shoulders.
रथतुर् रथ-तुर्, adj. Overpowering, i. e. drawing, the carriage, Chr. 293, 2 = Rigv. i. 88, 2.
रथधूर्गत रथधूर्गत, i. e. रथ-धुर्-गत (vb. गम्), adj. Gone upon the pole of the chariot, Johns. Sel. 15, 53.
रथारथि रथारथि, i. e. रथ-रथ + इ, adv. In mutual contact of the chariots, i. e. in closest fight, MBh. 4, 1056.
रथिक रथिक, i. e. रथ + इक, m. The owner of, or rider in, a car.

रथिन् रथिन्, i. e. रथ + ईन्,
 I. adj. Mounted on carriages, Rām. 3, 49, 18.
 II. m.
 1. The owner of, or rider in, a car, lord of chariots, Vikr. d. 100.
 2. A warrior who fights in a car, Draup. 2, 12; Utt. Rāmac. 130, 4.
 --Comp.
रथिन रथिन, and रथिर रथिर i. e. रथ + इन् + अ, and with र् for न्, m. The owner of, or rider in, a car.

रथ्य रथ्य, i. e. रथ + य,
 I. m. A carriage horse.
 II. f. या.
 1. A multitude of cars, Rājat. 5, 241 (warriors?).
 2. A high street.
 3. A place where several roads meet.
 III. n. A wheel.
रथ- + वाहक रथ- + वाहक, m. the driver of a carriage, Nal. 22, 1.
रथ- + शाला रथ- + शाला, f. a coach-house, Nal. 21, 29.
